name: Data.heightLe_liftVolume_ratio
summary: Write each lift volume through the comparison forms: normDet(goodLift)²·det(compressedGramOp) = 𝗁^{dim}·|γ|^{2dim}·normDet(A)²; with η = (θ ι)^j the ratio u(η)/u(1) of determinants of compressedGramOp has height at most 2·dim·r·B₀ (archimedean bound of the common multiplier u(1)) plus dim·r·B₀ (local exponents dim·r·β_ℓ, Σ_ℓ β_ℓ ≤ B₀ over every finite set of primes), and |γ(η)/γ(1)|² is the Hecke value ratio, whose inverse has height at most 10m x^999 + k(6B₀ − 𝖴).

steps.claim: From the fit family at j: numbers β_ℓ (a function of the prime ℓ) with Σ_{ℓ∈T} β_ℓ ≤ B₀ for every finite set T of primes (g), and the denominator bounds DenominatorLe(ι, e₀, range of goodLift((θ ι)^j, j), β_ℓ) at each ι (g') (IsFitFamily.denominator_le).
steps.lean:
(O.denominator_le j).elim fun β ⟨g, g'⟩ ↦ by
  rw [D.finrank_rows_eq_finrank_goodForms j, liftVolume, show TameChar.pow _ j =
    .one by rw [TameChar.pow]; congr <;> apply one_pow]
  obtain ⟨γ, A, gl, H, ad, sur, tst, int, S⟩ := exists_comparison_forms j
  have d ϑ := finrank_range_of_inj (f := D.goodLift ϑ j) (by simp [auxLift_injective])
  replace tst ϑ y :=
    (A.adjoint.map_smul ..).trans congr($(adjoint_comp_eq_conj_smul (ad ϑ)) y).symm ▸ tst ϑ _
  let u (ϑ : D.Twist) := (compressedGramOp (smallHookNumber j) (D.goodLift ϑ j).range (gl ϑ)).det
  have V ϑ : _ * u ϑ = _ := adjoint_comp_eq_conj_smul (ad ϑ) ▸ d ϑ ▸ det_compressedGramOp _
  have T ϑ := right_ne_zero_of_mul ((V ϑ).trans_ne (by simp [H,
    normDet_eq_zero_iff_ker_ne_bot, ← orthogonal_range, range_eq_top.2 sur]))
  have sep ϑ z (h : (gl ϑ).adjoint z.1 = 0) :=
    ker_eq_bot'.1 (equivOfDetNeZero _ (T ϑ)).ker z (by simp [compressedGramOp, h])
  refine O.heightLe_of_eq_zpow_mul (.mul (y := fun ι ↦ u ((θ ι).powTwist j) / u 1) ⟨_, _,
    (_ : ℕ) * (D.r * β), T 1, d _ ▸ norm_det_compressedGramOp_arch_le (sep 1)
    (fun | ⟨_, y, rfl⟩ => tst 1 y) rfl S, fun ι ↦ ?_, .of_forall
    fun _ ↦ by simp [← mul_sum]; grw [g]; simp⟩ ((heightLe_inv_heckeValueProd_div O j).pow _))
    (by rw [← mul_add, ← mul_add]; gcongr; simpa [mul_sub, add_sub] using D.le_of_hasLogBound) fun ι
    n ↦ ⟨0, by
    have := div_ne_zero_iff.1 n; simp [← (H _).2, field, div_pow, V 1, *]
    erw [V ((θ ι).powTwist j)]; simp; ring⟩
  exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (T 1) ▸ d _ ▸ norm_det_compressedGramOp_padic_le (sep _)
    (fun | ⟨_, y, rfl⟩ => tst _ y) ι (int _ · _ · (O.1 ι)) (g' ι).1

steps.claim: Rewrite the dimension of the rows as that of the good forms on W_j (finrank_rows_eq_finrank_goodForms), unfold liftVolume, and use step 1.2.
The j-th power of the trivial twist is the trivial twist (TameChar.pow, one_pow).

steps.claim: Comparison forms (exists_comparison_forms): γ, a surjection A from tables onto good forms, gl_ϑ with goodLift*∘gl_ϑ = γ(ϑ)A (ad), testing (tst), integrality (int) and the size bound at the trivial twist (S); |γ(ϑ)/γ(1)|² = Hecke value ratio (H).

steps.claim: u(ϑ) ≠ 0: the right side of step 1.7 is nonzero, since A is surjective (its adjoint injective) and γ ≠ 0.

steps.claim: gl_ϑ* is injective on the range of goodLift: compressedGramOp is invertible (det ≠ 0, step 1.8).

steps.claim: Height of the ratio: with η = (θ ι)^j (TameChar.powTwist), by step 1.7 liftVolume(1, j)/liftVolume(θ ι, j) = (u(η)/u(1))·(|γ(1)|²/|γ(η)|²)^{dim} = (u(η)/u(1))·(heckeValueProd(η)/heckeValueProd(1))^{−dim} (by H), exactly: heightLe_of_eq_zpow_mul is applied with exponent 0 of the norm of the modulus (line 123). The family ι ↦ u(η)/u(1) has height at most 2·dim·r·B₀ + dim·r·B₀: its common multiplier is u(1) ≠ 0 (step 1.8), with |σ(u(1))| ≤ exp(dim·2rB₀) at every σ (norm_det_compressedGramOp_arch_le at the trivial twist with the size bound S, β = 2rB₀); at ι the local exponent is dim·r·β_ℓ (step 1.11; HeightLe bounds |ι(H·y)| by exp(e_ℓ), with no factor log ℓ), and the sums of these exponents over the primes below any bound are at most dim·r·B₀ (g). The Hecke value part has height dim·(10m x^999 + k(6B₀ − 𝖴)) (heightLe_inv_heckeValueProd_div, power dim); the total 3·dim·r·B₀ + dim·(10m x^999 + k(6B₀ − 𝖴)) is at most rowDim·k·(log b·B₀ − 𝖴) on the scales (le_of_hasLogBound).
